goal_features.statement: The flexible curriculum spans systems, theoretical foundations and artificial intelligence. The department describes three or four semesters depending on preparation.

source_excerpt: The Computer Science Department offers its Pittsburgh MSCS with an individualized curriculum in systems, theory and AI. Preparation affects whether the usual duration is three or four semesters.
